confound_note: Hilbert transform applied to the raw, strictly-positive, trend-dominated gap sequence (not zero-mean/narrowband) as literally instructed. Pre-registered expectation (before running) was that the envelope would track local signal magnitude closely -- vs_mean_fit and vs_std_fit are mathematically identical (both curves are positive-slope affine transforms of the same ln(N+2), and Pearson r is invariant to that), so this is one comparison, not two. The actual result (r~0.17) is WEAK, contrary to the pre-stated expectation of high correlation -- reported as a genuine surprise, not evidence of hidden structure (a weak correlation is still consistent with 'no interesting structure', just not in the direction originally guessed).
